newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus sees 1997 net of three bln ffr.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus sees 1997 net of three bln ffr.

text.p: French pay-television group Canal Plus expects a net profit, at unchanged tax levels, of some three billion francs ($508.5 million) for 1997, finance director Laurent Perpere told Reuters.

He stressed the forecast did not take account of any changes in corporate taxes or taxes on capital gains that could be imposed by the new Socialist-led government. The profit is the result of a deal with Germany's Kirch Group which will lead to an exceptional gain of some three billion francs.
Before this deal Canal Plus expected to break-even for the year due to losses at the Nethold operations. ($ = 5.9 French Francs)
